data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was GBP 2,068.0m. During 2017 there was an adverse prior-year development: gross claims outstanding were strengthened by GBP 71.5m (c.3.46% of opening reserves). The movement is recorded in the technical reserves reconciliation and reflects overall adverse development / reserve strengthening; the report also records significant catastrophe activity in 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the Mexican earthquake and California wildfires) together with large loss development which contributed to the deterioration. Movements in reinsurers' share also influenced the net impact.
